[[Sharptooth's Shield]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Mahto Sharptooth]], a [[boss]] who is found in [[Sunward Marches]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
<!-- This is how it is displayed in-game, please do not remove it -->
:[[Inscription]]: "Master of My Domain"
:[[Tactics]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as the [[Sharktooth Shield]] [[dye]]d brown.

==Replica==
Except for visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is an [[Adamantine Shield]] from crafter [[Keeper of Arms]].
